stories.title: The Cost of Video Color Grading: From $800K to Free
stories.description: DaVinci Resolve, professional video editing software with color grading, once cost $800,000. Today it's either free (open source version) or $295. This dramatic price drop democratized video production, allowing creators worldwide to do what only well-funded studios could do before.
stories.insight: Technology makes expensive capabilities cheap. When tools become accessible, new creators enter fields and innovation accelerates exponentially.
stories.why_share_worthy: Concrete example of how technological progress creates abundance and opportunity, not through policy but through innovation.

core_ideas.title: Technology Democratizes Production: Barriers Vanish
core_ideas.description: As technology costs drop, barriers to entry in creative fields disappear. What required massive capital now requires only talent, effort, and internet access. Power shifts from gatekeepers to creators.
core_ideas.why_matters: Explains why internet era democratized publishing, music, video, and software. Opens opportunities for outsiders globally.

core_ideas.title: State Action Should Enable, Not Inhibit, Competition
core_ideas.description: The state's role isn't to pick winners but to ensure conditions where anyone can compete. Remove barriers, prevent monopolies, protect property rights—then let markets work.
core_ideas.why_matters: Practical framework for when state action helps (removing barriers) vs. hurts (creating monopolies, extracting rents).

core_ideas.title: Context-Dependent Governance: City vs. Village
core_ideas.description: A sprawling city like Mumbai has fundamentally different governance needs than a village. Population density, economic complexity, and social dynamics change what policies work. One-size-fits-all fails.
core_ideas.why_matters: Argues for subsidiarity and localization. Solutions must match their contexts.

jokes_and_cultural_references.quote: When the means of production become cheap, the mode of production changes.
jokes_and_cultural_references.author: Implied from technology discussion
jokes_and_cultural_references.context: As seen with DaVinci Resolve going from $800K to free, dramatically changing who can create video content
jokes_and_cultural_references.why_funny_and_insightful: Playful inversion of Marxist ideas using concrete technological example
